title: 第30章 没人看见
novel_title: 丰腴小村妇，大佬们跪求嫁给他(锦绣钱澄)
content_zh: 公安上门问话的时候，已经是深夜了。张家人出了张永福，都被叫起来集中在堂屋。徐喜弟三天内见两次公安，十分淡定。“赵小义昨天扛着刀来砍你们家院子了？”两名公安目光在张家人脸上来回审视，最后锁定一家之主张国海。“是，他爸干那些事……”张国海怕公安不知道原委，准备从赵丁的事说起。“我没问他爸，就说他！”公安打断了他的话。“他扛着刀，在门口骂人，说我们害他爸去吃牢饭……”“你来说。”公安把目光转向一边看起来比较正常一点的范金花。“赵小义他进院就砍，先砍的院门，门柱子两下就砍断了……”范金花得了说话的机会，一股脑把昨天发生的事讲了一遍。正要说到刘烨主动提出来修院子，又被公安打断。“行了，李队长，你安排两个人，和这位公安在张家、刘烨家还有李家，搜查搜查，看看有没有什么关键的证据。”“你带我去大队办公室，把李家人和刘烨都叫过去，咱们集中对对词。”大队长李祝雄在前面领路，手电筒的光柱在村道上乱晃。深夜的大队办公室很冷清，这里只有平日开会，才开门。刘烨很快就被叫过来，他坐在那张缺了角的长条凳上，谁坐他旁边都显单薄。李祝英两口子坐在对面。李婶眼睛红肿，显然是刚哭过。李祝英则是一脸阴沉，抱着手。“都到齐了吧。”公安拉过一张靠背椅，坐到正中央。“今天把大家叫来，不为别的，就为赵小义半夜被打、五十块钱被抢的事。”“赵小义咬定是刘烨干的，但刘烨说他没去过。李祝英，你家昨天半夜有什么动静没？”李祝英抬头，满脸的无辜和委屈，“公安同志，我家能有什么动静？我媳妇让人糟蹋了，我正愁得睡不着觉，哪有心思管别人家的闲事？”“听说你家昨天半夜门响过？”公安盯着他的眼睛。李祝英冷哼一声，“我起夜不行吗？我这岁数了，憋不住尿，一晚上起个三五回，这也犯法？”李婶在一旁抽噎，“公安同志，你们可得查清楚。赵小义那是活该，他爹干了缺德事，他跟着遭报应。可这事跟我们家没关系，我们家都是老实人。”公安没理会李婶的哭诉，转头看向刘烨。“刘烨，赵小义说打他的人个头很块，力气也大。这村子里，符合这条件的，除了你，找不出第二个。你真的没去过赵家？”刘烨抬起眼皮，眼神里透着股憨劲，还有些茫然。“我去赵家干嘛。我昨天傍晚去小羊山砍楠竹呢，手都磨破了。天都黑透了才回来，还在张家吃的晚饭，我到家凉都没冲，到头就睡了。”他伸出那双布满老茧的大手，掌心确实有几处红肿。“赵小义说，那五十块钱就压在枕头底下，打他的人拿了钱就跑。刘烨，你要是缺钱，可以跟大队说，抢劫可是重罪。”公安语气严厉了些。刘烨摇摇头，“我不缺钱。刘宇宁前几天刚给我二十块，我现在有钱，不用抢。”大队长李祝雄在一旁插话，“公安同志，刘烨这孩子我看着长大的，虽然脑子转得慢，但从不干偷鸡摸狗的事。”“倒是赵小义，那小子嘴里没句实话，指不定是自己把钱藏起来了，想栽赃嫁祸。”公安敲了敲桌子，“栽赃嫁祸也得有动机。刘烨，赵小义砍完院子，徐喜弟跟你说什么了？”“没说什么呀，他砍的时候，大伙全看见了，还用说什么？”刘烨老老实实回答。“那你心里气不气？”“我气啥，砍的又不是我家院子。我只管干活，上山砍竹子回来修了院子，张家给我管饭。”这回答滴水不漏，倒让公安有些无从下手。又把李家人逐一问了个遍，依旧毫无头绪。“一个个都说没打赵小义，但是赵小义腿是真被打断的，难道鬼打的？”老公安还真就不信邪。“既然你们都不认，那就只能动员全村，村子这么多人，总有人看见点啥，听见点啥。”没办法，李祝雄只能拿起大锣，出了会议室门口，就哐哐哐地一顿敲。“开会了，开会了！”“全都起来开会了，一个都不许落下！全体开会！”很快，村里就开始鸡飞狗跳起来。徐喜弟跟在范金花身后，缩着脖子往广场走。她偷偷瞄了一眼从会议室出来的刘烨，看他十分淡定，她心里有谱了。广场上，两盏昏黄的马灯挂在木柱子上，照出了一张张写满怨气的脸。“这都几点了？还让不让人活了？”“赵家那点烂事，非得折腾全村。赵丁进去还没两天，赵小义又闹出幺蛾子。”“听说是腿让人给废了，活该，这就是报应。”村民们一集中到广场，就开始议论纷纷。两名公安站在大队办公室门口的台阶上，脸色严峻。老公安眼神在人群里扫来扫去，像要把每个人都看穿。李祝雄抹了一把汗，走到台阶中间，拍了拍手。“都静一静！别嘟囔了！今天公安同志在这儿，是为了一桩大案子。昨天半夜，赵小义在家里让人给打了，腿骨断了，枕头底下的五十块钱也没了。”“这是入室抢劫，性质恶劣！谁要是看见了，或者听见什么动静，赶紧站出来说。别等公安查到你头上，到时候就不是说话这么简单了！”底下瞬间没了声，连咳嗽声都给憋了回去。王公安皱着眉头，继续喊道。“在座的各位，清溪村就这么大。谁家有个风吹草动，瞒得过谁？那五十块钱不是小数目，赵小义的腿也不是平白无故断的。”“大家都是乡里乡亲，谁要是知道点线索，私下跟我说也行。举报有功，政府不会亏待大家。”底下依旧是一片死寂。徐喜弟心里跟明镜似的。这村子里的人，虽然爱嚼舌根，但更懂得趋利避害。赵家父子平日里横行霸道，占地毁苗的事没少干。现在赵小义被打，大伙儿心里指不定还拍手叫好呢，谁会为了那两个混蛋去得罪一个能打断人腿的好汉？就是真有人看见了，大概也不会出来说的。底下一片安静，谁也不吭声。王公安在广场上来回走了两圈，他停在张国海面前。
content_en: It was already late at night when the police came to ask questions.After Zhang Yongfu came out of the Zhang family, they were all called up and gathered in the main room.Xu Xidi met with the police twice in three days and was very calm."Did Zhao Xiaoyi come to chop up your yard with a knife yesterday?" Two police officers looked back and forth at the faces of the Zhang family, and finally zeroed in on Zhang Guohai, the head of the family."Yes, his father did those things..." Zhang Guohai was afraid that the police would not know the whole story, so he planned to start with Zhao Ding's incident."I didn't ask about his father, so I just told him!" The police officer interrupted him."He was holding a knife and cursing people at the door, saying that we caused his father to go to jail..." "Tell me what you say." The police officer turned his attention to Fan Jinhua who looked more normal."Zhao Xiaoyi chopped it down as soon as he entered the courtyard. He chopped down the courtyard door first, and the door pillars were broken in two strokes..." Fan Jinhua got the chance to speak, and recounted what happened yesterday.Just as he was about to talk about Liu Ye's initiative to repair the yard, he was interrupted by the police."Okay, Captain Li, you arrange for two people to search with this policeman at Zhang's house, Liu Ye's house, and Li's house to see if there is any key evidence." "Take me to the brigade office, call the Li family and Liu Ye over, and let's focus on the conversation." Captain Li Zhuxiong led the way, and the beam of the flashlight flickered on the village road.The brigade office is deserted late at night. It is only open for meetings on weekdays.Liu Ye was quickly called over. He sat on the long bench with a corner missing. Anyone sitting next to him looked thin.Li Zhuying and his wife sat across from each other.Aunt Li's eyes were red and swollen, obviously she had just cried.Li Zhuying had a gloomy look on her face and folded her hands."Everyone is here." The policeman pulled up a chair and sat in the middle."I called everyone here today, for no other reason than that Zhao Xiaoyi was beaten in the middle of the night and robbed of fifty yuan." "Zhao Xiaoyi insisted that Liu Ye did it, but Liu Ye said that he had never been there. Li Zhuying, was there any movement at your house in the middle of the night last night?" Li Zhuying looked up., with a face full of innocence and grievance, "Comrade Public Security, what's going on at my house? My wife has been ruined by others, and I'm so worried that I can't sleep. How can I care about other people's business?" "I heard there was a knock on your door at midnight last night?" The policeman stared into his eyes.Li Zhuying snorted coldly, "Can't I get up at night? At my age, I can't hold back my urine. I get up three or five times a night. Is this illegal?" Aunt Li was sobbing on the side, "Comrade Public Security, you have to find out."Zhao Xiaoyi deserves it. His father did something immoral and he got retribution. But this matter has nothing to do with our family. We are all honest people."The police ignored Aunt Li's cry and turned to look at Liu Ye."Liu Ye, Zhao Xiaoyi said that the person who beat him was very big and very strong. Apart from you, there is no other person in this village who meets this condition. Have you really never been to Zhao's house?" Liu Ye raised his eyelids, his eyes full of naivety and a little confused."Why should I go to Zhao's house? I went to Xiaoyang Mountain to cut bamboos last night, and my hands were all worn out. I didn't come back until it was completely dark, and I had dinner at Zhang's house. I didn't even take a shower when I got home, so I fell asleep in the end." He stretched out his big calloused hands, and there were indeed a few red and swollen palms."Zhao Xiaoyi said that he put the fifty yuan under his pillow, and the person who beat him took the money and ran away. Liu Ye, if you are short of money, you can tell the brigade that robbery is a felony." The policeman's tone was stern.Liu Ye shook his head, "I'm not short of money. Liu Yuning just gave me 20 yuan a few days ago. I have money now, so there is no need to rob." Captain Li Zhuxiong interjected from the side, "Comrade Public Security, I watched Liu Ye grow up. Although his brain is slow, he never does anything sneaky." "On the other hand, Zhao Xiaoyi, that kid has no words.To be honest, maybe he hid the money and wanted to frame him." The policeman knocked on the table, "There must be a motive to frame the crime.Liu Ye, what did Zhao Xiaoyi say to you after he chopped the yard?" "You didn't say anything.Everyone saw it when he chopped it, so what else can you say?" Liu Ye answered honestly."Then are you angry?" "What am I angry about? It's not my yard that I'm cutting. I just work, go up the mountain to chop bamboo and build the yard, and the Zhang family takes care of the food for me." This answer was watertight, which made the police a little confused.I asked the Li family members one by one, but still had no clue."Everyone said they didn't beat Zhao Xiaoyi, but Zhao Xiaoyi's leg was really broken. Could it be that someone beat him?" The old police officer really didn't believe in evil."Since you all don't recognize it, we can only mobilize the whole village. With so many people in the village, there will always be someone who sees or hears something." There was no other way. Li Zhuxiong could only pick up the big gong, leave the door of the conference room, and bang it."It's a meeting, it's a meeting!" "Everyone is up for the meeting, no one is allowed to be left behind! It's a meeting for all!" Soon, the village began to jump up and down.Xu Xidi followed Fan Jinhua and walked toward the square with his neck hunched.She secretly glanced at Liu Ye coming out of the conference room and saw that he was very calm, which made her feel confident.In the square, two dim lanterns were hung on wooden pillars, illuminating faces full of resentment."What time is it? Are you going to let people live?" "The bad things about the Zhao family have to trouble the whole village. Not two days after Zhao Ding came in, Zhao Xiaoyi made trouble again." "I heard that his legs were crippled. He deserves it. This is retribution." The villagers gathered in the square and began to talk about it.Two police officers stood on the steps at the door of the brigade office with stern expressions on their faces.The old police officer's eyes swept around the crowd, as if he wanted to see through everyone.Li Zhuxiong wiped his sweat, walked to the middle of the steps, and clapped his hands."Everyone, be quiet! Stop mumbling! The police comrades are here today for a big case. In the middle of the night last night, Zhao Xiaoyi was beaten at home. His leg bones were broken, and the fifty yuan under the pillow was gone." "This is a home invasion robbery., is of a vile nature!If anyone sees or hears anything, please come forward and speak quickly.Don’t wait for the police to find out about you.Then it will not be as simple as saying anything!" There was no sound at the bottom, and even the coughing was suppressed.Wang Gongan frowned and continued to shout."Everyone here, Qingxi Village is so big. Who can hide something from someone? That fifty yuan is not a small amount, and Zhao Xiaoyi's leg was not broken for no reason." "We are all fellow villagers. If anyone knows some clues, you can tell me privately. If you report it, the government will not treat you badly." There is still a dead silence below.Xu Xidi felt like a mirror in his heart.Although the people in this village like to gossip, they also know how to seek advantages and avoid disadvantages.The Zhao family's father and son are usually domineering, occupying land and destroying seedlings.Now that Zhao Xiaoyi was beaten, everyone was still clapping and applauding in confusion. Who would offend a good man who could break someone's legs for those two bastards?Even if someone did see it, they probably wouldn't say anything.It was quiet down there, no one said a word.Wang Gongan walked back and forth twice in the square, and he stopped in front of Zhang Guohai.
